frontend.initial_design: Reuse the complete original source-informed combination frontend seed80 ten-point d1000 design, in its saved order.
frontend.online_candidates: Run the original full candidate and recommendation generator per arm. frontend.source_archive_scope: Each target family uses its two other-family archives only; the same 384 historical source calls are available to all three backends.

source_fit_scope.same_source_gp: Fit on the corresponding original 384-call archive; shared public mean10 plus learned risk10.
source_fit_scope.current_structural_mixture: Fit the current eight-identity four-head source model on the same archive and representation.
source_fit_scope.native_frontend: Restore the original source learner and its own online target updates.
source_fit_scope.source_fit_count: Record actual newly executed source/encoder fits and CPU; do not label this stage zero-fit.

source_integration.scope: Current structural source mixture for every family; same node count throughout this comparison.
source_integration.initial_256_node_attempt: Importance-overlap failure retained in source_fit_attempts.json; no source/target simulations were used to repair it.

source_fit_scope.fixed_quadrature_diagnostics: Minimum component ESS across retained source heads: FactorShock4.32059, Inventory28.85391, Queue4.74915. Maximum single-node mass below0.475; no further refinement, no numerical certification.

terminal.support: Freeze the backend primary, insert minimum empirical-objective policy from the original ten initial observations, retain original V69 observed safe support; unique three-policy shortlist frozen before independent verification.
terminal.truth_access: Only after all12 shortlists are frozen and all12 independent verifications finish; no outcome-based task/candidate selection.
terminal.decision_candidate_scope: observed policies from that arm initial and search history

budget.accounting: Report realized early-stop verification calls, reused initialization, source refits, numerical CPU and failed attempts separately; retain all prior ledgers.

comparisons: Compare three posterior systems under the same384 source calls, complete old frontend routes, constrained_ts/feasible_first rule, observed-only terminal scope and V69 verification. This is not a three-way identical-representation prior ablation.
Each online backend versus shared initialization-only support; distinguish primary recommendation and verified deployed policy.
scope: All three predetermined families and seed80; no selecting cases or candidates from truth, no importing Inventory-only calibration into other families.

numerical_recovery.change: Accept only roundoff status2 when finite positive integrals satisfy the existing normalized error estimate <=1e-8; requested quadrature tolerance remains1e-12.

task_contract: All arms use the same declared family parameters. FactorShock shared_shock_scale=1 matches the reused legacy_joint_bridge raw and base simulator default; the historical V69 scheduler default was0, so this is not a bitwise old-run reproduction.

decision_protocol.posterior_update: GP and current structural backend retain their native raw-observation posterior updates; original native backend retains its historical posterior machinery.
decision_protocol.acquisition_excludes: Do not substitute the recent order3 moment-KG or quality-times-certificate-power decision rule.
decision_protocol.candidate_scoring: Each new backend scores the original candidate pool; retain all original active proposal and recommendation routes.
decision_protocol.constrained_ts_projection: For GP/current, each response head is projected to its joint Gaussian mean/covariance across the original candidate pool for constrained TS selection; this is a decision approximation, not a replacement of the raw posterior.
decision_protocol.aleatoric_noise: For GP/current, use exact positive-mixture E[exp(eta)] from the retained posterior, not exp(E[eta]).
decision_protocol.representation_scope: GP and current structural backend share public mean10 and learned risk10 from the same 384-call archive; the native backend retains its historical representation and HVD.
